item.guhs.koivoer.tooltip: Hold it near the water: the koi come for a bite. Right-click the water to scatter a handful, nyeg!
item.guhs.koi_emmer.tooltip: Empty the bucket into your own pond: your koi will live there for good
gui.guhs.wolkenschaapje.gehouden: This cloud lamb stays with you now. Baa-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.koi: Rarity: Common (ponds of Babbledale and Blossom Lake)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koi: A chubby, calm pond fish with guh eyes, rosy cheeks and two round guh ears for fins. There are red-and-white, tricolor, pink, blue and golden koi. Hold koi food and they come up for a bite. Scoop one up with a bucket of water and it lives in your pond for good. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wolkenschaapje: Rarity: Only in the Cloud Meadow
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wolkenschaapje: A lamb that is almost all cloud. It floats a hand's width above the grass and drifts gently around. Snip it with shears for cloud fluff: after a while it is just as fluffy again. Give it nibble feed or take it along on a lead, and it stays with you. Baa-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bloesemguh: A blossom-white guh with pink petals in his fur and a little blossom by his ear. He likes to lie under the guh blossom trees by the water all day, and takes a nap on the shore in the evening. Tame him with cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.tanukiguh: A gray-brown guh with a dark little mask, a thick ringed bushy tail and a leaf on his head. Nobody knows why that leaf never falls off. Lives in Babbledale and naps by the babbling water in the evening. Tame him with cheese nibbles, nyeg!
